baseline.note: Introduce the explicit documentation review baseline for the existing application and release tooling without certifying historical behavior.

backup-recovery.migration: Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. Back up the closed database with adjacent originals and the profile before upgrade. Open a disposable copy first; the desktop profile migration retains compatibility access and refuses unsafe collisions. For rollback, preserve upgraded files and restore the complete pre-upgrade copy with the previous package; later edits are absent. DOCX expansion limits can refuse oversized inputs without changing stored books.
backup-recovery.no_impact: Salvage reports design rows verbatim and is unchanged; only a test fixture gained default fields for the new chapter options, so recovery behavior and archive contracts are unaffected.
backup-recovery.note: No recovery or backup behavior changes.

editor.note: Document chapter openers (ornament, its position, chapter sink) in the book preparation summary; the preview rail gains two option groups and three ornaments.

encryption.note: Distinguish encrypted portable archives from plaintext working files and add encryption dependency and source review obligations. Chapter openers change no encryption behavior; only a compatibility paragraph was added.

maintenance.no_impact: Renderer, paginator and test sources changed for chapter openers and CI runs one display-gated paginator test; contributor guidance, documentation checks and native-test exclusions are unchanged.

native-packaging.no_impact: CI gains one narrow display-gated paginator test step in the host job; packaging, release admission and artifacts are unchanged.
native-packaging.note: Require the latest exact-commit develop push CI run to succeed before alpha tag packaging; an older success cannot hide a pending or failed newer run. Existing platforms, asset publication, tag ancestry, application behavior, and compatibility remain unchanged. The host job also runs one display-gated proof paginator test.

project-format.migration: Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. Back up the closed database with adjacent originals and the profile before upgrade. Open a disposable copy first; the desktop profile migration retains compatibility access and refuses unsafe collisions. For rollback, preserve upgraded files and restore the complete pre-upgrade copy with the previous package; later edits are absent. DOCX expansion limits can refuse oversized inputs without changing stored books. Chapter openers add optional words (ornament-above, sink-third, sink-half) and three ornament names to the stored chapter options; older builds ignore them, so back up the closed book before upgrading as above and expect an older package to show the ornament below the title with no sink.
project-format.note: Chapter openers add optional words to the stored chapter options and three ornament names; the SQLite schema is unchanged and books without them render as before.
